title: Moya o o ineetseng wa kgabo e e boitshepo
intro: Fa pele ga gago go na le kgang ya bopelokgale jo bo sa tlwaelegang, e mo go yone motho a le mongwe a neng a le pelokgale go gwetlha ditumelo tse di tseneletseng thata tsa tlhabologo yotlhe. Latela ditshebo tseno tsa nako e e fetileng, mme o tla ribolola botshelo jo bo tshwailweng ke tumelo e e sa ineeleng, go falola ka kgakgamatso, le go thaya metheo e e neng e tla bopa loeto lwa semoya lwa dibilione. Trace mong le e mong motlhala ka hloko - mollo halalelang ntse hopola.
clues: Ke tsholetswe mo lelapeng le le neng le tlotla dilo tsa selegodimo le medingwana e e betlilweng, le fa go ntse jalo sengwe se se neng se le kwa teng mo teng ga me se ne se gana se ba neng ba se obamela.

Ke ne ka ema kgatlhanong le mmusi yo o nonofileng go gaisa botlhe wa lefatshe la gaetsho, ka thubaganya yone medingwana e batho ba gaetsho ba neng ba e obamela, mme ka bolela gore ke Mmopi wa magodimo fela yo o tshwanelwang ke go ineelwa.
Go ne ga laelwa gore go nne le molelo o o tukang mo leineng la me, mme ke ne ka bolela gore Yo ke mo direlang a le esi o tla mpoloka — mme dikgabo tsa laelwa gore di tsidifale le go babalesega.
Ke ne ka tlogela sengwe le sengwe se ke neng ke se tlwaetse ka taelo ya bomodimo, ke ya kwa le kwa mo mekgatšheng e e omileng le lelapa la gaetsho, ke ikanya paakanyetso e ke neng ke ise ke e bone.
Re eme fa thoko ga morwaake wa leitibolo mo mokgatšheng o o senang sepe, re ne ra tsosa mmogo metheo ya ntlo e e boitshepo, lefelo le le boitshepo le le diretsweng botlhe ba ba ikobang.
Ke itsege jaaka Khalilullah — tsala e e gaufi ya Mopelotlhomogi — mme leina la me le ne la golaganngwa ka bosakhutleng le tumelo ya go ineela le go ineela.

Go folosediwa mo mosimeng ke bakaulengwe ba lefufa

Go itshokela morwalela o mogolo mo teng ga sejana sa logong
trial.answer: Go latlhelwa mo molelong o o tukang ke mogateledi

outcome.label: Botso
options: O ne a itsege e le Khalilullah, tsala e kgolo ya ga Allah
O eteletse batho pele go kgabaganya lewatle le le kgaoganeng go ya kwa pabalesegong
O ne a newa taolo mo diphefong le mo maatleng a a sa bonweng

Kopanya merafe e le lesomepedi e e gasameng ka fa tlase ga kgolagano e le nngwe
outcome.answer: O ne a itsege e le Khalilullah, tsala e kgolo ya ga Allah

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verse: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh." (6:79)
